model.description: Cab model id. Only mtr:lift_1 exists. A later custom cab keeps this field and adds a model; unknown ids still draw lift_1.

walls.description: Wall panes: glass (see-through, the saved-world default) or opaque. Custom wall art is a later step: paint LiftGlassRegions wall rects, or set textureResource to an atlas that already has them filled. Not stored on the lift.

doors.description: Door panes: glass or opaque. Independent of walls so a later style can mix them (Minecraft-Transit-Railway issue 598). Door motion types stay on the model, not this field.
